{{short description|Canadian chemist}}
'''Pierre Deslongchamps''' {{Post-nominals|country=CAN|OC|FRS}} (born 1938 in [[Saint-Lin-Laurentides, Quebec]]) is a Canadian [[chemist]], and professor at [[Université de Sherbrooke]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://pages.usherbrooke.ca/pdeslongchamps/bio-sh.htm# |title=Biographie abrégée |access-date=2011-12-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120426041526/http://pages.usherbrooke.ca/pdeslongchamps/bio-sh.htm# |archive-date=2012-04-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
He was a 1979 [[Guggenheim Fellow]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.gf.org/fellows/3574-pierre-deslongchamps# |title=Pierre Deslongchamps - John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation |access-date=2011-12-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130104053845/http://www.gf.org/fellows/3574-pierre-deslongchamps# |archive-date=2013-01-04 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Life==
He graduated from the [[Université de Montreal]] with a BSc in 1959 and from [[University of New Brunswick]] with a PhD in 1964.
He studied at [[Harvard University]] with [[Robert Burns Woodward]].<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.science.ca/scientists/scientistprofile.php?pID=147|title=science.ca : Pierre Deslongchamps|publisher=}}</ref>

He is the Executive Scientific Advisor at OmegaChem.<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.omegachem.com/news/september-13-2008-pierre-deslongchamps-and-michel-couturier-join-omegachem.html# |title=Omegachem - September 13, 2008 Pierre Deslongchamps and Michel Couturier join OmegaChem |access-date=2011-12-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120426041737/http://www.omegachem.com/news/september-13-2008-pierre-deslongchamps-and-michel-couturier-join-omegachem.html# |archive-date=2012-04-26 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
